name: residual_direction_confidence_classifier_gross9_marginal_battery

familywise_ledger.eligible_top1: at most one pre2025 passing cell

prior_battery_boundary.familywise_stop: RDC-1 is the final battery permitted to reuse this exact 12-feature family on 2023/2024. If it fails, the family closes; no threshold, target, model, hold, or coordination repair may reopen it.
prior_battery_boundary.promotion_status: exploratory_forward_shadow even if pre2025 and contaminated historical future vetoes pass; live promotion additionally requires the frozen prospective gate.

hypothesis: Causal spot-perpetual and delayed inventory residuals may rank the better 6h/12h direction even when absolute risk-adjusted return regression is negative. A confidence-tail classifier can form a sparse bidirectional sleeve that improves frozen Gross9 versus identical configured gross.

feature_contract.spot_perp_semantics: Current completed-bar observations standardized against rolling history ending at t-1; rolling regressions are fitted through t-1.
feature_contract.inventory_semantics: For scoring year C in {2022,2023,2024}, conservation-residual regression coefficients are fitted only on rows with source timestamps and labels strictly before C-01-01. The resulting fold-local beta is applied to that fold; OI metrics remain delayed one complete 5m source bar and rolling z-scores use completed history.
forbidden_inputs: calendar identity beyond the annual expanding fit boundary
feature_contract.row_admission: All 12 fold-local declared feature values must be finite at completed signal bar t.

learner_contract.target: long when long_exact_net_return >= short_exact_net_return, otherwise short; both labels use the canonical 0.5x, 6bp/notional/side no-stop path
learner_contract.fit_purge: A label may enter a fit only when entry, every held return/adverse bar, and time exit are strictly before model_fit_end_exclusive.
learner_contract.score: For each seed read p_long from the classes_==1 column. mean_long=mean_seed(p_long), uncertainty=std_seed(p_long,ddof=0). Choose long when mean_long>=0.5, otherwise short. chosen_empirical_confidence=max(mean_long,1-mean_long)-0.5*uncertainty. This is an uncalibrated rank score, not a calibrated probability.
learner_contract.score_calibration: For each hold and prediction year Y, use np.quantile(chosen_empirical_confidence, 0.90, method="linear") over every finite hourly anchor in Y-1 whose complete path exits inside Y-1. This population is before coordination gates and before candidate non-overlap. It was predicted by a classifier and fold-local feature state fitted strictly before Y-1. Admit current-year anchors when score >= threshold. No absolute score floor is added.

class_encoding.predict_proba_long_column: the unique estimator.classes_ index equal to integer 1; every fit must contain both classes [0,1] or fail closed

learner_contract.random_state: Each estimator uses random_state equal to its declared seed.

execution_and_accounting.position_indices: For signal_position t and hold H, entry_position e=t+1. Return and adverse bars are j in the inclusive interval [e,e+H-1], each using OHLC at j and next open j+1. Time exit_position x=e+H and exit cost is charged at x. A fit/evaluation row is contained only when x is strictly before the boundary position.
execution_and_accounting.candidate_nonoverlap: Each policy is one sleeve. After accepting a signal at t and entering at e=t+1, ignore all later candidate signals with signal_position <= exit_position x; the next admissible signal_position is x+1. Candidate trades never stack or net.
execution_and_accounting.split_containment: Signals whose complete entry-through-exit path is not contained in the measured split are excluded.
execution_and_accounting.portfolio_clock: Gross9 and candidate paths share the same BTC 5m clock and same-BTC upper-before-lower strict-MDD accounting.
execution_and_accounting.calendar_metrics: Absolute return, CAGR, and strict MDD include every idle bar from the fixed calendar boundaries.
execution_and_accounting.gross9_drawdown_gate: At completed signal bar t, compare frozen Gross9 closing equity after t with its running upper-envelope peak through t; both are computed only from bars at or before t on one continuous 2020-09-01 through 2024-12-31 clock. The state does not reset at the 2024 selection boundary.

coordination_modes.name: gross9_flat_at_signal
coordination_modes.rule: The frozen Gross9 portfolio has no occupied sleeve bar at completed signal bar t.

coordination_modes.name: gross9_drawdown_ge_5pct
coordination_modes.rule: Frozen Gross9 equity after completed signal bar t is at least 5% below its running upper-envelope peak through t.

selection_2024.portfolio_engine_alias: test2024 is an internal historical array key only; it is part of pre-2025 selection and is not a held-out test

same_gross_formula.baseline_weights: Let frozen Gross9 sleeve weights be b_i with sum_i b_i = 9.
same_gross_formula.combined_candidate: For candidate allocation c in {0.25,0.50,0.75,1.00}, keep every b_i unchanged and add candidate weight c. Static configured gross is 9+c.
same_gross_formula.prorata_control: Use only Gross9 sleeves with control weight b_i * (9+c)/9. The control's static configured gross is exactly 9+c.
same_gross_formula.gross_interpretation: This is static configured sleeve gross, matching the frozen portfolio engine. It is not barwise active notional matching; zero active Gross9 exposure requires no special denominator rule.
same_gross_formula.candidate_unit: Candidate weight 1.0 multiplies its canonical 0.5x unit path once.

metric_formulas.equity: E_t = product_{u<=t} max(0, 1+r_u); E_before,t = 1 for the first bar and E_{t-1} afterward
metric_formulas.ohlc_envelope: low_t = E_before,t * max(0,1+sum_i weight_i*L_i,t); high_t = E_before,t * max(0,1+sum_i weight_i*H_i,t)
metric_formulas.cagr_pct: 100*(E_last^(1/calendar_years)-1), where calendar_years is exact end_exclusive-start_inclusive seconds divided by 365.25 days
metric_formulas.entry_jaccard: For each Gross9 sleeve, compute |candidate_entries intersect sleeve_entries| / |candidate_entries union sleeve_entries| using exact global entry positions restricted to 2023-01-01 through 2024-12-31; admission uses the maximum across sleeves.
metric_formulas.same_gross_ratio_improvement: For window W, improvement_W = cagr_to_strict_mdd(combined_candidate,W) - cagr_to_strict_mdd(prorata_control,W), an absolute ratio-point difference.
metric_formulas.signed_geometric_mean_same_gross_ratio_i: Let p=improvement_train*improvement_selection_2024. Return 0 when p=0; return sqrt(abs(p)) only when both improvements are positive; otherwise return -sqrt(abs(p)).
metric_formulas.nan_policy: Any non-finite metric or comparison fails admission.

selection_contract.numeric_comparison_precision: Use unrounded float64 metrics; displayed rounding never enters selection.

stress_semantics.normal_selection: All return-retention, same-gross comparator improvement, MDD, and Jaccard gates use Gross9 at frozen 6bp/side and candidate at normal 6bp/side.
stress_semantics.candidate_stress: Replay identical candidate model, feature states, scores, thresholds, sides, and entries at candidate-only 10bp/notional/side; Gross9 and the same-gross control remain at frozen 6bp/side.
stress_semantics.stress_admission: Stressed candidate standalone absolute return must be strictly >0 in selection_2023 and selection_2024. The combined portfolio with normal-cost Gross9 plus stressed candidate must be strictly >0 in Gross9 train and selection_2024. The same-gross control is not stress-reranked.
stress_semantics.comparison_operators: MDD caps use <=; return retention and same-gross ratio improvement use >=; positive-return and MDD-reduction requirements use strict >.

future_veto_contract.research_contamination: 2025/2026 have been inspected elsewhere and can never provide pristine confirmation.

prospective_live_promotion_gate.starts_after: RDC-1 exact top1 code, model states, thresholds, and weight are committed and remain unchanged
prospective_live_promotion_gate.any_failure: reject live promotion; no parameter repair under this family

future_veto_contract.july_2026_scope: outside historical selection; may count prospectively only if it occurs after the immutable freeze start
